## Implementations of Claude Code

The same Claude Code underneath. Only the window around it differs.

::: {.two-cards}
::: {.card-blue}
[CLI]{.card-title}

The original. Type `claude` in a terminal. Everything else here is this same program.
:::
::: {.card-amber}
[Claude Desktop]{.card-title}

Anthropic's own app, with four versions of Claude. Claude Code Local is the version that matches.
:::
:::

::: {.two-cards}
::: {.card-teal}
[IDE extension]{.card-title}

An embedding of Claude Code in a software development tool, for example VS Code or JetBrains.
:::
::: {.card-purple}
[Academic Studio]{.card-title}

A specialized build of VS Code, that strips out tools we don't need for using Claude and adds a Claude menu and pre-installed extensions.
:::
:::

## Install

Download for your machine at [academic-studio.com](https://academic-studio.com) and run it --- on Windows an installer, on a Mac a disk image you drag into Applications. Accept the license agreement and all the defaults.

::: {.two-cards}
::: {.card-blue}
[If Windows objects]{.card-title}

SmartScreen may say it protected your PC. Choose [More Info]{.accent}, then [Run Anyway]{.accent} --- you may have to expand the More Info box before the button appears.
:::
::: {.card-amber}
[On a Mac]{.card-title}

A warning here too, but a milder one. Because the build is signed and notarized, macOS [asks rather than blocks]{.accent} --- are you sure you want to open an app downloaded from the internet? Choose Open.
:::
:::

## Run Setup

On first launch, [Run Setup]{.accent} --- from the Welcome tab, or `Help → Run Setup`. 

Choose the Student/Professional profile and press Apply for the extensions, then Install Selected Programs for the supporting software.

## Open a Folder

Like Claude Desktop, Academic Studio uses Claude inside a folder.

Open the folder you want to work in from the Welcome tab 
 or `File → Open Folder`. Claude Code opens automatically beside it.

## Log In

On first use, you need to connect to your Anthropic account.

Enter `/login` at the prompt window and follow the instructions.  Your $20 Pro account will work fine (same as Claude Desktop).

## Take the Tour

From the Welcome tab or `Help → Tour of Academic Studio`, take the tour --- a short slide deck explaining how to work in Academic Studio

## Ask Claude for Help

Tell Claude you are working in Academic Studio and give Claude the link [academic-studio.com](https://academic-studio.com). Then ask Claude for help on anything about working in Academic Studio.

## Use Claude

- You can do everything we have done in class by prompting Claude in Academic Studio.

- Start by asking Claude to connect to the https://lab-aug.rice-business.org/eia/mcp server.

- Notice the Claude menu.  Try setting permissions, installing skills, ...
